description: DNS records for a domain. Use when a task needs a domain's live A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS or CAA records in one structured answer, including whether the name exists at all. Cost: 1 credit per call.

domain.description: The domain to look up. A URL is accepted and its host is used.

types.description: Any of A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS, CAA. Defaults to all six.

name: dns_lookup
